recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-26069; future extension-definition changes should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack, while core should continue to reference the workflowStatusDescription canonical where relevant.
issue_request: FHIR-26069 asked to rename the ValueSet extension valueset-workflowStatus to workflowStatusDescription because the value is a string/description rather than a coded workflow status. Its final Published/Persuasive resolution says it is a duplicate of FHIR-26550 and that no technical change was needed from this ticket because FHIR-26550 had already been applied.
initial_application: FHIR-26550 approved the rename. After an initial reverted attempt in 9fca6ca36f, commit 054eabf3116825c0f65107fedff6668447bf43a1 created the renamed workflowStatusDescription extension definition/reference in R5-era core source, and b89a83b4b7fa2bec4cbaf92672d13c943c7772d5 corrected the ValueSet.status comment link to the renamed extension.
additional_context: ValueSet remains an active core resource, and current core ValueSet.status points to the workflowStatusDescription canonical. The extension definition itself was later removed from core by dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 along with other extension definitions. The FHIR Extension Pack currently contains StructureDefinition-valueset-workflowStatusDescription.xml with the renamed canonical and retains the old valueset-workflowStatus artifact as retired with a replacement note. FHIR-31955, already represented on the combined branch, confirms the same Extension Pack ownership context for later wording on this extension family.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source was changed. The seed duplicate was already satisfied by the FHIR-26550 application history, and the current authoritative extension definition is outside this checkout and already correct in the Extension Pack.

related_jiras.note: Formal duplicate target that approved and applied the workflowStatus to workflowStatusDescription rename.
